description: Defines classes and methods for Android shared audio sink using AudioTrack, including AudioTrackAudioSinkType and AudioTrackAudioSink, with functions for buffer management, thread handling, and error reporting.

classes.name: AudioTrackAudioSinkType
classes.description: Class managing creation, validation, and testing of Android audio sink type using AudioTrack.

classes.name: AudioTrackAudioSink
classes.description: Implementation of audio sink using Android's AudioTrack, handling buffer writing, thread management, and error reporting.

methods.name: GetMinBufferSizeInFrames
methods.description: Calculates minimum buffer size in frames based on channels, sample type, and sampling frequency.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates an audio sink instance with specified parameters.

methods.name: IsValid
methods.description: Checks if the given audio sink is valid and of this type.

methods.name: Destroy
methods.description: Destroys the specified audio sink instance.

methods.name: TestMinRequiredFrames
methods.description: Tests minimum required frames for buffer underrun prevention.

methods.name: SetPlaybackRate
methods.description: Sets the playback rate for the audio sink.

methods.name: SetVolume
methods.description: Sets the volume level for the audio sink.

methods.name: GetUnderrunCount
methods.description: Returns the count of buffer underruns.

methods.name: GetStartThresholdInFrames
methods.description: Returns the start threshold in frames.
